mods.name: Eternal Return
mods.description: A total conversion for Minecraft. Part one reworks enchanting: enchant capacity per material, inherent material enchantments, XP-free tables and anvils, chiseled bookshelf biasing, max levels raised to V, Mending removed, Curse of Invisibility.
